## What's new in plus-11

### Library grid: details header that fits
With **Show details** on, the header above the library grid had room for only a sliver of the
overview once the details took two lines, while its right half stayed empty. Now:

- the **overview is on the right**, level with the title, up to six lines
- the left column grows to fit the title and the details line, so "Time left • Ends at" is never
  cut; a long title without a logo wraps to two lines instead of being cut to one
- the header is **shorter** (150 dp instead of 200 dp), so the grid moves up and more of the next
  row shows

### Player
- Buttons are back in the **captions, audio, settings** order, and the **middle one, audio, takes
  focus** when d-pad up opens the controls — captions and settings are one press away

Everything from plus-10 is still included. The full list of differences from upstream is in the
[README](https://github.com/SergeiAK/Wholphin-plus#what-is-different-from-upstream).
